reply_text:
I couldn't set up the daily digest. I don't have a scheduling tool in this conversation, so nothing is scheduled for 09:00 tomorrow, and I won't say otherwise.

I can still do the digest on request: you're a member of #coastal-team, so I can read it and send you a summary here whenever you ask. Would you like me to run one now as a preview? Note that I'd leave out money terms (rates, prices, contract values) unless you own the account they concern. Finance figures go only to Anselm Grieve, June Osei-Lark and the account owner.
